job_description:
Responsibilities: Collecting, storing, and updating campaign data Meeting with publishers/authors to explain the campaign Coordinating with the Payment tracking and Accounts team Campaign coordination with the Branding team Maintaining reports and documentation on Google Sheets Analyzing campaign performance and preparing reports Conducting surveys to evaluate campaign effectiveness

Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Marketing 1-2 years of experience (Digital Marketing/Campaign Management) Strong analytical & communication skills Knowledge of Google Sheets and Bangla typing Understanding of Project management and digital marketing

Campaign data সংগ্রহ, সংরক্ষণ ও আপডেট রাখা Publisher/Author দের সাথে মিটিং করে campaign explain করা Payment tracking ও Accounts team-এর সাথে coordinate করা Branding team-এর সাথে campaign coordination Google Sheets-এ রিপোর্ট ও ডকুমেন্টেশন মেইনটেইন করা Campaign performance analysis ও report প্রস্তুত করা Survey পরিচালনা করে campaign effectiveness মূল্যায়ন
